metadata.title: The Midnight Will Reading
metadata.subtitle: They kicked me from the family chat as a 'charity adoptee'—until the midnight DNA will proved I'm the biological heiress swapped at birth.

nodes.text: 11:30 PM · Thirty minutes before your late adoptive father’s $300M will is read, a harsh system chime flashes: "Celeste removed Paige from Sterling Family Group."
Don’t bother coming to the midnight will reading, Paige! You’re just a charity orphan Dad pitied—every cent of the $300M goes to his biological daughter, ME!
I stayed by Dad’s hospital bed every night for two years while you partied in Monaco, Celeste. I’m coming to pay my respects, not beg for money.
Miss Paige, save yourself the embarrassment. The estate is strictly reserved for bloodline heirs—security has orders to bar you at the gate.
Thank god nobody ever checked why Celeste looks exactly like my late wife...

nodes.prompt: Your phone suddenly pings from an unknown encrypted notary line:

options.label: Read Judge Evelyn’s sealed summons
options.player_reply_text: Judge Evelyn? Why did Dad leave a separate private notary outside Mr. Vance?

options.label: Check the hidden hospital bracelet Dad gave you

nodes.text: Judge Evelyn’s encrypted seal flashes gold: "Your father suspected Lawyer Vance—and ordered a secret DNA codicil opened at midnight!"
Come to the side library gate in 10 minutes, Paige. Your father left a shock that will level this mansion.
You pull out the tiny faded hospital band your father pressed into your hand before passing—its birth timestamp matches CELESTE’S exact birthday!
Hold onto that bracelet, Paige! Meet me at the library door—we’re walking into the reading at 11:59 PM!
Thunder rolls across the Sterling estate as you slip through the rain toward the side library door.
Ready, Paige? At midnight, the fake heiress and Lawyer Vance are going down together.

nodes.headline: 11:59 PM
nodes.teaser_text: Celeste pops champagne ready to claim $300 million—one minute before Judge Evelyn opens the secret DNA codicil.

nodes.text: 11:59 PM · The grandfather clock chimes twelve. Just as Lawyer Vance reaches to read his version of the will, the library doors swing wide!
WHO LET THE ORPHAN IN?! Security, throw Paige back into the rain!!
Sit down, Celeste! I am Supreme Notary Evelyn—and your father revoked Mr. Vance’s power of attorney three months before he died!

nodes.transcript: [voice trembling in panic] "Impossible!! I’ve been the Sterling family attorney for twenty-five years! That codicil is fake!"

nodes.text: Did the old man run a DNA test before he died?! Oh god, if he tested Celeste...

nodes.prompt: Judge Evelyn holds up a crimson-sealed lab packet:

options.label: Ask Evelyn to read the DNA results aloud
options.player_reply_text: You insisted only bloodline heirs belong in this room, Celeste. Let’s check the blood.

options.label: Watch Lawyer Vance’s face as the seal breaks

nodes.text: Judge Evelyn slices the wax seal open—and every relative in the hall gasps as she projects the forensic chart!
DNA Match to Late Patriarch: Celeste = 0.00%. Paige = 99.99% BIOLOGICAL DAUGHTER!
As the seal cracks, Lawyer Vance staggers backward knocking over a crystal lamp—his guilty terror unmistakable!
And the second match? Celeste is 99.99% the biological daughter of LAWYER VANCE!!
Dead silence freezes the mansion. Celeste’s champagne flute shatters against the marble floor.
NO!! THAT’S A LIE!! Mr. Vance—tell them I’m NOT your daughter!!

nodes.headline: Swapped At Birth
nodes.teaser_text: Twenty-four years ago, Lawyer Vance swapped his own newborn daughter with the patriarch’s heiress—and placed YOU in an orphanage.

nodes.text: 12:10 AM · Judge Evelyn holds up the certified lab sheet under the chandelier as relatives recoil from Lawyer Vance.
Wait... Dad adopted me from St. Mary’s Orphanage because he felt an instant bond—and he finally realized the truth before he died!
Yes, Paige. He found the maternity nurse’s confession three months ago—and quietly rewrote the entire $300M will to you!

nodes.caption: Certified Forensic DNA Report: Paige (99.99% Heir) vs Celeste (0.00% — biological child of Vance).

nodes.text: Get to the study safe and grab the bearer bonds before Evelyn calls the police!

nodes.prompt: Lawyer Vance edges toward the dark corridor leading to the study safe:

options.label: Alert police officers waiting outside the hall
options.player_reply_text: Going to raid the study safe, Mr. Vance? Too bad police are blocking every door.

options.label: Reveal the study safe was already emptied by Dad

nodes.text: Four detectives step smoothly through the French doors, cutting off Vance’s escape route.
Arrest warrant for infant abduction, conspiracy, and $300M inheritance fraud!
Judge Evelyn smiles coldly: "Your father moved every bearer bond to Geneva two months ago—leaving only a tracker inside that safe!"
The old man outplayed me from beyond the grave!!
Steel cuffs lock onto Lawyer Vance’s wrists while Celeste breaks down sobbing on the velvet rug.
Wait—am I going to lose my penthouse, my trust fund, EVERYTHING?! Paige, I’m sorry for kicking you out of the group chat!!

nodes.headline: The $300M Verdict
nodes.teaser_text: Celeste begs for mercy—but Judge Evelyn still has one final sealed video message from your father.

nodes.text: 12:25 AM · After police escort Vance out, the hall hushes as your father’s warm, gentle face appears on the library screen.
Evelyn whispers gently: "Watch closely, Paige—your father recorded this the night you fell asleep holding his hand."
Note flashes: "Father’s final message unlocked—100% Sterling Group control vests in Paige."
Dad... you knew the whole time, and you still made sure I was safe before exposing Vance.

nodes.transcript: [playing father’s final clause] "To my true daughter Paige: you loved me when you thought you owed me everything—now the entire Sterling Empire is yours."

nodes.prompt: The relatives who mocked you now bow awkwardly asking your plans for Celeste:

options.label: Revoke her cards & tell her to earn a living
options.player_reply_text: You didn’t commit the swap, Celeste—so I won’t jail you. Pack your bags by noon and get a real job.

options.label: Claw back every luxury gift Vance siphoned

nodes.text: Celeste nods tearfully, humbled for the first time in her pampered life.
I’ll pack tonight... thank you for not ruining me completely, Paige.
Judge Evelyn’s forensic audit recovers $18M in Monaco condos and yachts Vance secretly siphoned for Celeste!
$18M reclaimed straight back into your father’s Orphanage Foundation!
As dawn breaks, Judge Evelyn hands you the heavy sterling-silver estate master key.
Wait—check the family group chat! Your uncle just added you back as "Group Admin"!

nodes.headline: Back In The Group Chat
nodes.teaser_text: The same relatives who stayed silent when Celeste kicked you out are now groveling—unaware a boardroom coup is brewing.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Sterling Holdings HQ. Two greedy uncles try to block your chairmanship, claiming an "orphanage girl" lacks executive experience!
They’re bluffing, Paige! You hold 78% voting shares—and they don’t know you secretly graduated top of your MBA class!
Let them talk for two minutes—then show them the Q4 restructuring plan I wrote with Dad from his hospital room.

nodes.caption: 78% Majority Voting Charter + Signed Q4 Growth Strategy co-authored by Paige.

nodes.text: Wait till the uncles see their own bloated consulting contracts get cut!

nodes.prompt: You take the head chair of Sterling Holdings:

options.label: Present the Q4 plan & cut fake uncle salaries
options.player_reply_text: I drafted the Q4 plan that saved this company last quarter—and today we cut every no-show executive salary.

options.label: Buy out their 10% stakes & go 100% independent

nodes.text: Independent directors erupt in applause as both greedy uncles sink red-faced into their chairs.
Unanimous vote! Welcome, Chairwoman Paige!
You invoke the buyout clause—cleanly buying out both uncles so zero family parasites remain on the board!
Clean board, clean vision—Sterling stock just hit an all-time high!
Outside the glass boardroom, employees cheer as your name goes up on the Chairwoman’s suite.
Your father is smiling down right now, Paige.

nodes.headline: Chairwoman Sterling
nodes.teaser_text: With the empire secured, you return to the one place that raised you—St. Mary’s Orphanage.

nodes.text: 3:00 PM · St. Mary’s Orphanage. Children run laughing across the courtyard as you arrive with Judge Evelyn.
That $18M we recovered from Vance’s hidden accounts? It just funded a brand-new campus, library, and college trust for every child here!
Being raised here wasn’t a curse, Evelyn—it taught me how to love people for who they are, not what they own.

nodes.transcript: [wiping a proud tear] "That’s exactly why your father knew you were the only true heiress."

nodes.text: Every child here deserves a fair shot.

nodes.prompt: Unveil the cornerstone plaque of the new campus:

options.label: Name it after your late father
options.player_reply_text: In honor of the man who found his daughter twice.

options.label: Guarantee Sterling internships for every grad

nodes.text: Sunlight gleams off the bronze plaque as children cheer around the courtyard.
A legacy that will outlive us all.
Every orphan who graduates high school now has a guaranteed full-ride scholarship and career path at Sterling Holdings!
You’re changing hundreds of lives, Paige!
As you head back toward the gate, a familiar figure in a simple café uniform waves shyly from across the street.
Hi Paige... I got my first real job at the bakery across the street. Just wanted to say I’m truly sorry for everything.

nodes.headline: Across The Street
nodes.teaser_text: The former spoiled heiress finally learned humility—and one quiet moment brings closure to 24 years of pain.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Corner Bakery. You step inside and order two warm coffees as Celeste hands you a paper cup without a trace of her old arrogance.
My father—Vance—pled guilty today. He got 18 years. For the first time, I’m earning my own rent instead of living a stolen life.
It takes courage to start over honestly, Celeste. Keep at it.

nodes.transcript: [genuine smile] "Thank you for sparing me, Paige. You really are the real heiress."

nodes.text: Peace feels better than revenge ever could.

nodes.prompt: Leave a tip on the counter before heading out:

options.label: Wish her luck & walk into the sunshine
options.player_reply_text: Take care, Celeste. Make your own name proud.

options.label: Order 50 pastries for St. Mary’s kids

nodes.text: You step out into the golden afternoon—light, whole, and completely free of the past.
Grace under fire, Paige. Pure royalty.
You pay for 50 warm pastries to be delivered across the street—turning Celeste’s honest work into smiles for the kids!
I’ll bake them extra fresh right now!!
The shadows of 24 years finally lift beneath a crystal-clear sky.
Sterling Annual Summit next week—ready for your keynote?

nodes.headline: The Summit
nodes.teaser_text: Next week you take the global stage as the undisputed Chairwoman of Sterling Holdings.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Sterling Grand Auditorium. Two thousand global partners applaud as you unveil the company’s next decade.
Valuation just crossed $500 MILLION! You nearly doubled your father’s empire in six months!
Couldn’t have done it without the best team—and Dad’s blueprint.

nodes.transcript: [over standing ovation] "Long live Chairwoman Paige Sterling!"

nodes.text: We made it, Dad.

options.label: Dedicate the milestone to your father
options.player_reply_text: For the father who never stopped searching for the truth.

options.label: Double the Orphanage Foundation endowment

nodes.text: Warm applause echoes across the hall as your father’s legacy shines brighter than ever.
Unforgettable, Paige.
You pledge $40M to build ten new St. Mary’s campuses across the country—turning your story into hope for thousands!
The whole country is cheering your name tonight!
From kicked out of the family chat to leading a half-billion-dollar empire.
Thank you, everyone.

nodes.headline: One Year Later
nodes.teaser_text: One year after the midnight will reading, Sterling Mansion hosts a celebration of light.

nodes.text: 7:00 PM · Sterling Mansion Gardens. Warm lanterns glow across the lawn as children from St. Mary’s and loyal staff celebrate together.
Look at this house—a year ago it was cold and scheming. Tonight it’s full of laughter!
That’s what a real family looks like, Evelyn.
Happy anniversary, Dad.

nodes.prompt: Light the golden centerpiece lantern in the garden:

options.label: Make a wish for peace & truth
options.player_reply_text: May truth always find its way home.

options.label: Launch fireworks over Sterling Estate

nodes.text: Golden light blooms across the garden, warming every smiling face.
Amen to that, Paige.
Brilliant gold-and-violet fireworks paint the night sky as the kids cheer in wonder!
Magical night!!
The true heiress stands surrounded by genuine love—no fake smiles, no stolen crowns.
Home at last.

nodes.headline: Epilogue · The True Crown
nodes.teaser_text: One final midnight chime marks a brand-new legacy.

nodes.text: 11:59 PM · Sterling Library Balcony. Exactly one year after the midnight will reading, the grandfather clock chimes twelve in pure peace.
One year ago tonight, you walked in from the rain. Tonight you own the whole horizon, Paige.
And I’ll spend every year making sure it counts.

nodes.transcript: [soft toast] "To Chairwoman Paige—the true Sterling heir!"

nodes.text: Thank you for everything, Dad.

nodes.prompt: Look out over the starlit estate at midnight:

options.label: Hold the tiny hospital bracelet & smile
options.player_reply_text: Truth always wins in the end.

options.label: Toast to the future with Judge Evelyn

nodes.text: Starlight shines gently over Sterling Mansion—your rightful home forever.
Goodnight, Dad.
Glasses chime cleanly under the midnight stars—a legend sealed in gold.
To a bright eternity, Paige!
Swapped at birth, mocked as an orphan, crowned as sovereign—your story is complete.
The crown is finally home.

nodes.headline: Finale · The True Heiress
nodes.teaser_text: Lawyer Vance is jailed, the birth-swap conspiracy is shattered, and you lead the $500M Sterling Empire with grace.
